questions.cardText:
[History] Between which two countries was the first known peace treaty signed?
A. Egypt and Greece
B. Egypt and Hittite Empire
C. Macedonia and Persia
Answer: B. The Treaty of Kadesh was signed between the Egyptian Pharaoh Ramses II and the Hittite King Hattusili III around 1259 BCE. A copy of the Treaty of Kadesh is displayed on a wall at the United Nations Headquarters in New York City, symbolizing its importance as a historical milestone in diplomacy and peacekeeping.
questions.de: Mit welchem Reich schloss Ägypten unter Ramses II. um 1259 v. Chr. den ältesten erhaltenen Friedensvertrag?
questions.en: Egypt under Ramesses II made the oldest known surviving peace treaty, around 1259 BC, with which empire?

timeline.labelEn: Ramesses II of Egypt and Hattusili III of the Hittites conclude their peace treaty
timeline.labelDe: Ramses II. von Ägypten und der Hethiterkönig Ḫattušili III. schließen ihren Friedensvertrag

questions.notes: Card overstates: Wikipedia calls it the oldest known SURVIVING peace treaty; the older Ebla–Abarsal treaty may be the earliest recorded diplomatic treaty. 'Treaty of Kadesh' is a popular name for the Egyptian–Hittite peace treaty (also 'Eternal Treaty'); the UN-headquarters copy and c. 1259 BC are confirmed.

questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] Which of the following species lived during the Jurassic period?
A. Tyrannosaurus rex
B. Stegosaurus
C. Woolly Mammoth
Answer: B.
questions.de: In welchem Erdzeitalter lebte der Plattendinosaurier Stegosaurus?
questions.en: During which geological period did the plated dinosaur Stegosaurus live?

timeline.labelEn: Stegosaurus lives in North America and Europe during the Late Jurassic
timeline.labelDe: Stegosaurus lebt im Oberjura in Nordamerika und Europa

questions.notes: Reworked from 'which of the following' to the underlying fact. Fossil range Kimmeridgian–Tithonian, c. 155–145 million years ago (Wikipedia). 'Jurassic' alone is also acceptable.
